t2.title: It better to study online or in the classroom
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it better to study online or in the classroom?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Online vs Classroom: Finding the Right Balance

The debate over online versus classroom learning has intensified in recent years. Both methods have distinct advantages, making the choice dependent on individual circumstances.

Online learning offers unparalleled flexibility. Students can study at their own pace and access materials from anywhere. This is particularly beneficial for those balancing work or family commitments. Moreover, it eliminates commuting time and costs.

However, traditional classrooms provide face-to-face interaction that many students find invaluable. Teachers can offer immediate feedback and adapt their teaching to students' needs. The social aspect of learning with peers also promotes teamwork skills and motivation.

Furthermore, some subjects, such as science practicals or arts, clearly benefit from hands-on experience that only classrooms can provide.

Ultimately, a blended approach combining online resources with classroom sessions may be the ideal solution. This would offer flexibility while maintaining the human connection essential for effective learning.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear Manager,

I am writing to give you some feedback about my shopping experience in your store. Overall, I think the shop is good. I usually find what I need without any problems. The staff are also helpful, and they always try to answer my questions.

However, sometimes the queues at the checkout are very long, especially on weekends. I think it would be better if you had more open checkouts during busy times. Also, maybe you could offer more discounts on some products? That would encourage me to shop there more often.

Thank you for considering my suggestions. I hope they are helpful.

Sincerely,
A Regular Customer
t2.sampleB2:
Online or Classroom: Where Does Real Learning Happen?

Ask any student today and you will get a different answer — some swear by studying from home, while others cannot picture learning without a real classroom. So which one actually works better? There is no denying that online learning has its perks. You can study at your own pace, replay a tricky lesson, and skip the daily commute altogether. For anyone juggling a part-time job or family life, that flexibility can be a real game-changer, especially when deadlines start piling up. On the other hand, the classroom offers something a screen simply cannot. Being face to face with a teacher means you get instant feedback, and working alongside classmates keeps you motivated on days when your energy is running low. Let's be honest — it is far easier to switch off when nobody is watching. In my view, the smartest option is to mix the two. A blended approach lets you enjoy the freedom of online study while holding on to the human side of learning. After all, why settle for one when you can have the best of both worlds?
t2.uzSample:
Onlayn va Sinfda Ta’lim: To‘g‘ri Muvofaqatni Topish

Onlayn va sinfda ta’lim bo‘yicha bahslar so‘nggi yillarda kuchaydi. Ikkala usul ham o‘ziga xos afzalliklarga ega, bu tanlovni individual sharoitlarga bog‘liq qiladi.

Onlayn ta’lim misli ko‘rilmagan moslashuvchanlikni taklif etadi. Talabalar o‘z tezligida o‘qishlari va materiallarga istalgan joydan kirishlari mumkin. Bu, ayniqsa, ish yoki oilaviy majburiyatlarni muvozanatlashtirayotganlar uchun foydalidir. Bundan tashqari, u qatnash vaqtini va xarajatlarni yo‘q qiladi.

Biroq, an’anaviy sinflar ko‘plab talabalar qimmatli deb biladigan yuzma-yuz muloqotni ta’minlaydi. O‘qituvchilar darhol fikr-mulohaza bildirishlari va o‘qitishni talabalarning ehtiyojlariga moslashtirishlari mumkin. Tengdoshlar bilan o‘rganishning ijtimoiy jihati ham jamoaviy ishlash ko‘nikmalarini va motivatsiyani oshiradi.

Bundan tashqari, ba’zi fanlar, masalan, amaliyot fanlari yoki san’at, faqat sinflar ta’minlay oladigan amaliy tajribadan aniq foyda oladi.

Yakuniy xulosa shuki, onlayn resurslarni sinf mashg‘ulotlari bilan birlashtirgan aralash yondashuv ideal yechim bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu moslashuvchanlikni ta’minlagan holda, samarali o‘rganish uchun zarur bo‘lgan insoniy aloqani saqlab qoladi.

Sizning do'koningiz menga yoqadi va men ko'p narsalarni sotib olaman. Men oziq-ovqatni topishni oson deb bilaman va xodimlar yaxshi. Ular menga yordam berishadi. Lekin do'kon ba'zan gavjum bo'ladi. Ehtimol, kassada ko'proq odam bo'lishi mumkin? Bu yaxshi bo'lardi. Rahmat.

Hurmatli menejer,

Men sizning do'koningizdagi xarid tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, do'kon yaxshi deb o'ylayman. Odatda, menga kerakli narsalarni hech qanday muammosiz topaman. Xodimlar ham yordam berishadi va har doim savollarimga javob berishga harakat qilishadi.

Biroq, ba'zida kassadagi navbatlar juda uzun bo'ladi, ayniqsa dam olish kunlarida. O'ylashimcha, agar band paytlarda ko'proq ochiq kassalar bo'lsa, yaxshiroq bo'lardi. Shuningdek, balki ba'zi mahsulotlarga ko'proq chegirmalar taklif qila olarsiz? Bu meni u yerda tez-tez xarid qilishga undagan bo'lardi.

Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun rahmat. Umid qilaman, ular foydali bo'ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Doimiy mijoz
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Menejer,

Men sizning supermarketingizda yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan xaridlarim haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men mavjud mahsulotlar assortimenti va do'konning umumiy tozaligidan mamnunman. Odatda, menga kerak bo'lgan narsani qiyinchiliksiz topaman va xodimlar odatda murojaat qilganda xushmuomala va yordam berishadi.

Biroq, men yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalarni payqadim. Birinchidan, kassadagi navbat tizimi samarasiz bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa eng gavjum soatlarda. Tezlashtirilgan yo'laklar yoki qo'shimcha o'z-o'ziga xizmat ko'rsatish variantlari kabi yanada soddalashtirilgan jarayonni joriy etish bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, xodimlar odatda yordam berishsa-da, ularning mahsulot haqidagi bilimlarini oshirish mumkin. Ehtimol, muntazam trening mashg'ulotlari bu masalani hal qilishi mumkin.

Nihoyat, men mahalliy dehqonlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash va xaridorlarga yanada yangi mahsulotlarni taklif qilish uchun ko'proq mahalliy manbalardan olingan mahsulotlarni joriy etish foydali bo'ladi, deb hisoblayman. Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. Umid qilamanki, ular yanada yaxshi xarid qilish muhitiga hissa qo'shadi.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrdon Xaridor

t12.title: formal letter · to manager
t12.prompt: Write a letter to your manager. Write about your feelings and what you think the store management should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Manager,

Thank you for the opportunity to share my feedback. I am a frequent shopper at your store and generally have a positive experience.

Firstly, I would like to commend your staff for their helpful attitude. They are always willing to assist and provide excellent service.

However, I would like to suggest some improvements. The checkout queues can be quite long during peak hours. Adding more self-service tills could significantly reduce waiting times.

Additionally, clearer aisle labeling would help customers find products more efficiently. Sometimes it takes a while to locate specific items.

Overall, I enjoy shopping at your store and appreciate your commitment to improvement.

Best regards,
A Regular Customer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Manager,
I go to your shop. It is ok.
I buy bread and milk.
The shop man is nice. He helps me.
More sweets please.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Manager,
Thank you for your email. I like your shop. I can find most things, and the shop is near my house. But sometimes it is busy and the lines are long. The staff are friendly, and they help me if I ask. I think you should have more people at the checkout. Also, it would be good if the shop was open later on Sundays because I work during the week. Thank you.
From, A Customer
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Manager,

Thank you for asking for my feedback about the supermarket. I usually find what I need, but sometimes certain products are out of stock, which is frustrating. The staff are generally helpful, although it depends on who you ask – some are more knowledgeable than others.

In my opinion, you could improve the layout of the fruit and vegetable section. It often looks messy, and it's difficult to find good quality produce. Also, I think a loyalty program would encourage me to shop there more often. Maybe offering discounts on certain items or points for every purchase.

Overall, I am satisfied with the supermarket, but these changes would make it even better.

Sincerely,
A Valued Customer
t12.sampleB2: Dear Manager, Thank you for taking the time to ask for my feedback. As a regular customer at your supermarket, I am pleased to share a few thoughts. On the whole, I have a positive experience whenever I shop with you. The store is clean and well stocked, and your staff are consistently friendly and quick to lend a hand when I cannot find something. That said, there are a couple of areas that could be improved. The checkout queues tend to build up during peak hours, which can be frustrating after a long day. Installing additional self-service tills would go a long way towards easing the congestion. I would also suggest clearer aisle signs, as locating certain products can take longer than it should. Thank you for considering my suggestions. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev

Fikrimni bildirish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Men sizning do'koningizda tez-tez xarid qilaman va odatda ijobiy tajribaga egaman.

Avvalo, xodimlaringizni yordam berishga tayyorligi uchun maqtamoqchiman. Ular doimo yordam berishga va a'lo darajadagi xizmat ko'rsatishga tayyor.

Biroq, ba'zi takliflarim bor. Kassadagi navbatlar eng gavjum soatlarda ancha uzun bo'lishi mumkin. O'z-o'ziga xizmat ko'rsatish kassalarini ko'paytirish kutish vaqtini sezilarli darajada qisqartirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, tokchalarning aniqroq belgilanishi xaridorlarga mahsulotlarni yanada samarali topishga yordam beradi. Ba'zan muayyan narsalarni topish uchun biroz vaqt ketadi.

Umuman olganda, men sizning do'koningizda xarid qilishdan zavqlanaman va takomillashtirishga bo'lgan sadoqatingizni qadrlayman.

Xodimlar do'stona munosabatda bo'lishadi va agar so'rasam, yordam berishadi. O'ylashimcha, kassada ko'proq odam bo'lishi kerak. t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Menejer,

Supermarket haqida fikrlarimni so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Odatda menga kerakli narsalarni topaman, lekin ba'zida ayrim mahsulotlar sotuvda bo'lmay qoladi, bu esa meni xafa qiladi. Xodimlar odatda yordam berishadi, garchi bu kimga murojaat qilishingizga bog'liq – ba'zilari boshqalarga qaraganda ko'proq bilimga ega.

Mening fikrimcha, meva va sabzavotlar bo'limining joylashuvini yaxshilashingiz mumkin. U ko'pincha tartibsiz ko'rinadi va sifatli mahsulotlarni topish qiyin. Shuningdek, menimcha, sodiqlik dasturi meni u yerda tez-tez xarid qilishga undaydi. Ehtimol, ayrim mahsulotlarga chegirmalar yoki har bir xarid uchun ballar taklif qilish mumkin.

Umuman olganda, men supermarketdan mamnunman, lekin bu o'zgarishlar uni yanada yaxshiroq qiladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrlanadigan Mijoz
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Menejer,

Do'koningizdagi so'nggi xarid tajribalarim haqida fikr bildirish imkoniyatini berganingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, sizning supermarketingizning qulayligi va tanlovini qadrlasam ham, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud.

Birinchidan, xodimlarning aksariyati yoqimli bo'lsa-da, ayniqsa gavjum soatlarda yordam topishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelgan holatlarim bo'lgan. Ehtimol, xodimlarni qo'shimcha o'qitish, ayniqsa mahsulotlarning joylashuvi bo'yicha, foydali bo'lar edi. Ikkinchidan, men tokcha yorliqlari va kassadagi tizim o'rtasida narxlarning aniqligida nomuvofiqliklarni sezdim. Bu nomuvofiqlik juda asabiylashishi mumkin va mijozlarning ishonchini yo'qotadi.

Nihoyat, men ayniqsa meva-sabzavot bo'limida plastik qadoqlashni kamaytirish variantlarini o'rganishni taklif qilaman. Ko'pgina mijozlar tobora atrof-muhitga e'tiborli bo'lib bormoqda va ko'proq qadoqlanmagan yoki minimal darajada qadoqlangan variantlarni taklif qilish mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadi. O'ylaymanki, bu muammolarni hal qilish umumiy xarid tajribasini sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirli Xaridor
